title: Reference counting cannot collect a cycle
body: Counting references frees an object the moment its count hits zero, promptly and predictably. But two objects referencing only each other keep both counts at one forever, leaked in a loop no one points to. Tracing collectors exist largely to reclaim exactly those islands, by walking from roots instead of counting.
source_hint: Jones, Hosking and Moss, 'The Garbage Collection Handbook'
